text:
kevin_sales: Handoff: Orchid Labs signed a 60d pilot. PO received. Go-live target 2025-11-03. Requirements: HIPAA BAA, SAML SSO, private control plane (preferred) or dedicated reserved GPUs, audit log export to their Splunk, clinician feedback capture for quality. Expected load ~14k tokens/day, peak ~8 concurrent sessions. Customer contact: jess@orchidlabs.ai. Asset pack: https://drive.red/orchid-pilot

lina_cs: I'll own onboarding and clinician enablement. Quick clarifiers: 1) Is 12mo log retention required for pilot or negotiable? 2) Do they want Splunk HEC or S3 delivery?

kevin_sales: They prefer Splunk HEC and asked for 12mo retention but open to default 90 days for pilot. No model fine-tuning in pilot.

omar_support: Opening infra ticket. Need SAML IdP metadata (XML), VPC CIDR for peering, Splunk HEC endpoint + token (or S3 ARN), signed BAA, and webhook URL for feedback ingestion. ETA to provision private plane: ~3 business days after artifacts.

sylvie_eng: Perf note: with 8 concurrent sessions and avg 600 tokens/session p99 should be OK on private plane if we warm a small dedicated pool during 0800-1600 local clinic TZ. Need eval prompt set (30) and expected session length distribution to size KV cache. If they want autoscale for unexpected bursts estimate +15-25% cost.

prio_security: Will review BAA/DPA and their security questionnaire. HSM-backed key storage required; HSM provisioning adds ~3 business days. Also need to confirm data retention and tokenization policy.

lina_cs: Drafting action owners: CS: lina_cs (onboarding + clinician enablement + rollout comms), Support: omar_support (infra & tickets), Eng: sylvie_eng (capacity + perf sims + canary), Security: prio_security (BAA/HSM review), Sales: kevin_sales (contract artifacts).

lina_cs: Quick onboarding checklist to send customer at kickoff:
```
- Signed BAA (scan to security@redwood.com)
- SAML IdP metadata (IdP XML + cert)
- VPC CIDR + peering contact
- Splunk HEC URL + token OR S3 bucket ARN
- Eval prompt set (~30 prompts) + top-10 critical prompts
- Feedback webhook URL + auth method
- Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h windows
```

infra-bot: ticket CS-9983 created by omar_support - infra.provision.privateplane

omar_support: Scheduling tech kickoff Tue 2025-10-14 11:00am PT (placeholder). Will invite customer once artifacts in ticket.

sylvie_eng: I'll run perf sims on their eval set (q8 quant + non-quant). If top-10 prompts degrade >2% on clinical prompts, recommend non-quant canary. Also will estimate warm pool size and KV cache sizing.

kevin_sales: Renewal risk: medium. Pilot is the gating event for a multi-region roll. Key risks: delays on BAA/HSM and any latency impacting clinician workflow. Sales will track sentiment weekly and flag issues early.

lina_cs: Health plan: weekly health sync Fridays until pilot end. Set health flag "onboarding: awaiting artifacts" until SAML + BAA + Splunk details received. Escalation: if infra or security blockers exceed 6 business days escalate to Head of CS and VP Eng; if clinician testing blocked >5 business days escalate to CRO.

prio_security: Also request SOC2 report and security contact for questionnaire. Posting requirements to ticket.

kevin_sales: Looping customer in now to request SAML metadata, BAA, and webhook. Will update thread when artifacts arrive. Thanks team :thumbsup:
